gui._comment_stepDirs: Folders holding the component STEP models, searched IN ORDER - the first one that holds a given model file wins. So a project-local folder listed above the shared library overrides individual models. Each folder is searched recursively, so subfolders need no entry of their own. Edit here or in the GUI, one folder per line. stepDir below is the older single-folder key, kept in step with the first entry so an older build of the tool still works; stepDirs wins when both are present.
gui._comment_silkscreenFlatHeight: Distance in mm from the board surface to the surface of a FLAT silkscreen, so that graphics do not flicker where the two would otherwise be coplanar. Not the ink thickness - that is settings.silkscreenThickness, and it applies to solid silkscreen only. 1 um is invisible at board scale; raise it to 0.005-0.01 if a particular viewer still flickers. Ignored when silkscreenFlat is false.
gui._comment_silkscreenLayersOff: Silkscreen layers left out of the build, by name, as ticked in the GUI's Silkscreen layers panel. Exclusions rather than inclusions on purpose: a layer that turns up on a board for the first time is drawn, instead of going missing with nothing on screen to say why. Empty means every collected layer is built.
gui._comment_windowGeometry: Where the window was when it was last closed, as Tk's WIDTHxHEIGHT+X+Y. Restored on the next run, so on a multi-monitor desk it comes back on the same screen (X may be negative for a monitor left of the primary). If the position is no longer reachable - typically the monitor it was on has been disconnected - it is ignored and the window is centred on the main screen instead. Delete this key to get the centred first-run placement back. windowState remembers whether it was maximized.
